Carry this updated token and target identity into the next exchange without restarting from the original grasp location. Resolve participation using the updated token, not the original location. An exchange involving the target's new location and a third location moves it onward to that third location; two exchanges of the same pair restore the identities at those locations. Finish all exchanges before locating the target in the initial execution scene. This tracking is performed within the first decision step; do not store exchange history in persistent memory.
